notes.title: Highrise 2.0
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Updated Models - slightly nicer models for player and enemies(with added snazzy ties).
[*]Changes to Weapons - minor adjustments to stats plus a new revolver that can pierce enemies.
[*]New Boss Fights - Created 5 Unique boss fights that are better and more enjoyable than the previous ones.
[*]Dark Levels - certain levels will be in the dark, and the player will have to use their torch for better vision.
[*]Room Clutter - Added Furniture to the rooms so they are less barren.
[/list]
